operation_bindings.query_signature: Scalar $x$ in the extended spectral interval

comparators.definition: Compute the Lanczos approximation $\widehat y$ to $h(A)b$ in the stated floating-point model. The base loss is $\|\widehat y-h(A)b\|_2/\|b\|_2$ with threshold $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{out}}$. Define $\delta_k=\inf_{\deg q<k}\max_{x\in[a-\eta,b_{\mathrm{spec}}+\eta]}|q(x)-h(x)|$, the polynomial-approximation error in the source bound.

domains.definition: Return $\widehat y\in\mathbb R^d$ produced by the specified finite-precision algorithm. A separate error certificate is not required.

norms.definition: Use the Euclidean vector norm $\|z\|_2=(\sum_i|z_i|^2)^{1/2}$ and the matrix operator norm $\|M\|_{\rm op}=\max_{\|z\|_2=1}\|Mz\|_2$.

objects.definition: Assume $A=A^{\mathsf T}\in\mathbb R^{d\times d}$ with spectrum in $[a,b_{\mathrm{spec}}]$, $\|A\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\Lambda$, and $b\in\mathbb R^d\setminus\{0\}$. The function $h$ satisfies $|h(x)|\le C_h$ on the extended interval $[a-\eta,b_{\mathrm{spec}}+\eta]$, where $0<\eta\le\|A\|_{\mathrm{op}}$.
The tuple $(d,a,b_{\rm spec},\Lambda,h,b,\eta,C_h,k,\varepsilon_{\rm round},\varepsilon_{\rm out},b_{\rm fp},u)$ is public. Mantissa length and roundoff follow the fixed binary-rounding convention.
